biggest_catch: Credit is applied after the referred friend enrolls and makes their initial payment; no stated posting timeline and no stated cash value.
catches: Active Acacia Energy customer refers friends/family; friend calls 1-844-223-2158 to sign up and provides the referrer's account number (or name + service address).
$30 account credit is applied once the referred friend is enrolled and makes their initial payment — 'you will receive a $30 credit instantly' after those conditions.
No limitation on the number of people you can refer; each qualifying referral earns $30.
Additional $10 credit if your referral refers one of their own friends or family to Acacia Energy.
Acacia Energy is a Texas retail electric provider (Brooklet Energy Distribution, LLC DBA Acacia Energy, PUCT Certificate No. 10137); USD.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

steps: Be an active Acacia Energy customer and share your account number (or name + service address) with friends/family.
Friend calls 1-844-223-2158 and signs up for an Acacia Energy electric plan, giving your account number.
Friend makes their initial payment; a $30 credit is applied to your account.
Repeat without limit — each qualifying referral earns another $30.
If your referral refers someone else, you get an additional $10 credit.
timing: Credit after referred friend enrolls and makes initial payment.
